text:
emma: Heads-up: Legal wants stronger controls for audit exports of routing-policy changes. They asked for pre-auth and an immutable export manifest with actor provenance.

 dave: Pre-auth meaning: UI blocks presigned link generation until an approval flow completes?

 emma: Yes. Ideally the console triggers a request that includes export_reason + approver list. If high-sensitivity, approval required before bundle generation.

 anita: We should also limit full exports by default (e.g., 1 per 7d) and auto-fallback to sampled NDJSON for heavy tenants. Our parquet worker OOMs for giant tenants.

 dave: API draft: POST /v1/exports -> returns { export_id, status: queued|needs_approval }. If needs_approval we create an approval ticket with approvers and estimated_size.

 export-bot: export queued: export_id=exp-4340001111 mode=sample status=queued est_seconds=45

 anita: Payload should include actor_aliases snapshot and mapping so downstream SIEMs can reconcile SSO rename events. Include a manifest.json in the bundle with export_id, files, snapshot_time, sampling_rate.

 dave: Security asks: MFA re-auth for downloading full dumps, and presign event must be logged in audit logs with principal + IP.

 legal: Also require retention policy on presigned links. Default 24h ok, but add escalation path (court/subpoena) with extended retention via approvals.

 emma: UX idea: show compact proof preview inline (top 20 diffs) with a "Request full archive" button. The modal collects export_reason, contact, and whether this is machine-initiated.

 anita: Machine-initiated exports need a justification field in the API. If requested_by is a machine principal, require reason and a service account owner.

 dave: Telemetry list: exports.request.count, exports.mode.sample/exports.mode.full, exports.approval.latency_ms, exports.presign.count, exports.presign.fail.count, exports.bytes.generated. Add a dashboard card for "Exports awaiting approval" and "Full exports used in window".

 export-bot: created issue #4872 for export approval flow + manifest + quotas

 emma: Edge-case: retries for failed presign should re-evaluate quota and approvals. Also ensure we never leak presigned links in error pages or logs.

 anita: Implementation notes: worker writes manifest to object store alongside parts; presign uses manifest.export_id param; console fetches manifest to render CTA and proof anchor. Sampling fallback should be automatic when queue depth > 30 or estimated size > threshold.

 dave: I'll sketch the API PR and a console modal mock. Can we review with Security + Legal tomorrow 11:00am PT?

 legal: Confirmed. We'll look at approval language and retention during sync.

 emma: Thanks all, logging follow-ups in the issue and will ping after the meeting.
